text:
Your biggest enemy isn't the obstacle. It's how weak your want is.

You see the barrier and stop. Others see the same barrier and move it.

It's not luck, smarts, or money. It's want.

A man with nothing wanted so badly every obstacle became a puzzle. He rode a freight train. He got in. Most men would have quit before they started.

He wanted it more than comfort, safety, being liked.

When your want is bigger than your fear, the obstacle can't stop you.

Start wanting harder.
caption:
Your mindset and self discipline determine if obstacles stop you or move you. Success habits come from wanting more than you fear.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
